description: Webhook and email notifications with secret masking and bounded retries

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Send a JSON webhook notification with automatic retries on failure
notify.output: Dictionary with status, attempts and HTTP status code

webhook_url.label: Webhook URL
webhook_url.description: Absolute http(s) webhook endpoint (treated as a secret)

max_retries.label: Max Retries
max_retries.description: Extra delivery attempts after a failure

backoff_base.label: Backoff Base
backoff_base.description: Base delay between retries in seconds; doubles on every retry

send_email.name: Send Email
send_email.description: Send an email via SMTP using STARTTLS or implicit TLS; passwords resolve only through secret references
send_email.output: Dictionary with status, recipients, attachment count and TLS mode

username_secret.label: Username
username_secret.description: SMTP username, plain or a secret reference (<provider>://<namespace>/<key>)

password_secret_ref.label: Password Secret Ref
password_secret_ref.description: Secret reference to the SMTP password (<provider>://<namespace>/<key>); inline passwords are rejected by design

use_ssl.label: Use SSL
use_ssl.description: Use implicit TLS (SMTP_SSL); mutually exclusive with STARTTLS
